description: Internal benchmark case pack for porosity/shrinkage calibration gates. Re-baselined 2026-08-14 (2nd pass) after the conservative two-point-flux fix and mold-penetration boundary: solidification times are physical (~100-400 s); the graphite chill now cuts chill-side solidification time to ~40% of baseline and reduces side porosity; riser posts carry less porosity than riser bodies.

cases.notes: post_porosity_to_riser_ratio_max 1.70 re-checked 2026-08-14 (2nd pass): measured ~0.47 after the conservative flux fix (riser body now holds the porosity; the post/neck stays feedable). Threshold remains a loose upper bound.

side_solidification_time_ratio_max 1.05 re-checked 2026-08-14 (2nd pass): measured ~0.40 after the conservative flux fix (chill now accelerates the chill side). side_porosity_ratio measured ~0.70. Both gates enforce the chill benefit.

cast_shrinkage_mean_ratio_max 0.95 re-checked 2026-08-14 (2nd pass): measured ~0.56 after the conservative flux fix. Two risers still reduce cast shrinkage. Case is flaky (trimesh SIGTRAP, pre-existing).
